problem:
Consider the linear transformation $T$ with matrix representation $T,$ given by

$$
T=[\begin{aligned}3 & 2 \\ 4 & 1\end{aligned}].
$$

What are the coordinates of the point ${F}^{′}$, the image of $F(2,-2)$ under the action of $T?$
worked_solution:
To find the image of $F$ under the action of $T$, we first create a column-vector $x$ containing the coordinates of $F:$

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -2\end{aligned}].
$$

Now, we compute the image of $x$ under the action of $T$ by calculating the matrix product $Tx:$

$$
\begin{aligned}Tx & =[\begin{aligned}3 & 2 \\ 4 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2 \\ -2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 6\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

The result, $Tx,$ contains the coordinates of ${F}^{′}.$ Therefore, ${F}^{′}(2,6).$
